name: webtourismus/schema_org
description: Server-rendered schema.org structured data (JSON-LD) for Webtourismus Drupal projects: hotel profile, website, pages, breadcrumbs, rooms and offers.

suggest.webtourismus/ebr: Provides booking deeplinks (seekda, DIRS21, ...) used as Offer URLs.
